# Sea Swimming

Swims at the north beach, logged in the [[Lighthouse App]].

## Rules I keep

- Wetsuit below 14 C water, skins above that.
- Swim on a rising tide, two hours either side of high water, using the times from the [[Tide Data Source]].
- Never alone in October to April.

## Season so far

Coldest swim was 9 C in March, 12 minutes. Warmest was 18 C in late August. Bring a flask of tea and a woolly hat, the walk back up the cliff is when the cold hits.
